visual_identity.core_identity: An ancient skeletal spellcaster preserved by forbidden magic, combining unmistakable undead anatomy with deliberate arcane intelligence.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall robed skeletal humanoid with exposed skull and hands, one deliberate spellcasting gesture, robes falling in simple vertical shapes.
visual_identity.head_features: Bare or partly hooded skull with deep sockets, intact jaw, and severe ancient profile.
visual_identity.body_shape: Dry skeletal humanoid frame under decayed layered robes, bony hands visible, upright commanding posture.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Two skeletal arms and two skeletal legs beneath robes; hands and skull must remain visibly bony and anatomically coherent.
visual_identity.surface: Clean bone planes and torn fabric edges; no gore, slime, or dense decay.

accuracy_checks: skull and hands are clearly skeletal

known_failure_modes.correction: restore skeletal skull and dry bone anatomy
use severe skull proportions and commanding posture
return to simple decayed robes with exposed skull and hands

scene_identity.size_impression: Medium humanoid scale but visually imposing through upright posture and deliberate command of nearby ritual space.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Standing or seated with feet/body fully supported; gestures are deliberate rather than explosive.
behavior_style: standing over an altar or vault feature
environment_fit: deep arcane chambers and ritual spaces
